text: Viessmann Generations Group is the Viessmann family's company, led by fourth-generation CEO Max Viessmann. In 2024 the family company combined its climate-solutions business with Carrier Global; the Viessmann brand is owned by Viessmann Generations Group and licensed to Carrier.
short: Viessmann Generations Group is the Viessmann family company and owns the Viessmann brand (licensed to Carrier).

source.name: Viessmann Generations Group: 'Viessmann and Germany SailGP Team Unveil New Official Partnership at ENEL Rio Sail Grand Prix Debut'
source.quote: In 2024, the family company combined its climate solutions business area with Carrier Global to build a new transatlantic partnership
